scope: G07 shared required/empty-value validation, container-aware dynamic checks, error focus and attachment continuity in original local forms

sources.evidence: Optional wholly empty rows skip child required checks; any populated child activates row checks; required subforms need content.
Rich text supports text formatting, links and images. Image-only value handling is validated against supported rendering, not an exact source empty-HTML implementation claim.
Field validation runs on submission; visibility/editability and workflow overrides are described separately.

Inspected required initialization from allowBlank and the base checkValidate visibility gate. Kept visible readonly required constraints; full source entry-specific permission behavior is not established by this excerpt.

changes: Ordinary strings are checked literally; only rich-text values use sanitized rendered text/image content. Reuse existing sanitizer and native inert template parsing, with no new parser/dependency.
Dynamic validation traverses container visibility and optional editable-only scope before children; malformed subform rows retain primary shape errors instead of crashing secondary checks.
Shared submit focus includes invalid subform cells and prefers rich-text editable bodies over toolbar selects.

Attachment cancellation observes semantic file values and field configuration/permissions, not recreated array references caused by editing an unrelated field. Actual replacement, readonly and unmount still invalidate stale completion.

verified: Created and configured through UI; empty submission identifies five editable main-field errors. REF-001 readonly required default remains intact.
Literal <待补充> and numeric 0 pass; blank rich text, address and attachment fail. Optional empty subform row does not trigger child required.
Saving incomplete draft and cold reloading retains identity and inputs. Rich-text error focuses 图片说明 body (contenteditable=true), not the alignment selector.
Inserted only a synthetic SYN-OCR.png image in required rich text, chose 浙江省/杭州市/西湖区 and synthetic detail text, uploaded synthetic attachment.
Reproduced attachment disappearing when editing another field during upload, then repeated after fix; attachment persisted while updating 申请说明.
Row quantity 0 activates 商品编号 required; 390x844 submission focuses 商品明细 第1行 商品编号. Correcting with literal <SKU> succeeds.
Full draft cold reload retains rich image, file, address, readonly default and zero values. Mobile submission converts original draft to a single submitted record under the same ID.
Edited that record to <验收完成>, cold reloaded; same ID, one record, two loaded images, REF-001, <SKU> and both zero values retained. Browser warn/error logs empty; viewport reset.

limits: Complete all-field/source/member/workflow required semantics remain G07/R1/R5; visible readonly required remains enforced. No workflow behavior redesign.
Hidden-container invalid-choice cases and stale-upload timing are deterministic automated regressions; do not describe them as complete source-product or browser combination parity.
Original local forms verified. Backend build only; native database/API runtime, accounts, migration and server rich-text support not verified or completed.
Record-list rich-text summaries still expose literal blank entities and omit image-only descriptions; registered under R4. Rich-text body and file render correctly.
G09 visible-tab/insertion synchronization remains next; G02 word limits, maximum-image persistence and final visual/full-journey checks remain in existing queue.
